messages:
luis Ramirez: :rotating_light: LAX1 edge-pop degraded — customers reporting increased 5xxs and timeouts for streaming responses. Not all regions affected. Paging on-call.
oncall-bot: @devon KLINE — you are the primary on-call (rotation #7). Incident created: INC-2029-LAX1-EDGE. Pager sent.
devon Kline: On it. I'm looking at the edge metrics now. Early signal is HTTP 503 from nginx edge, upstreams timing out to us-west1 pools.
incident-bot: Auto-detected spike: HTTP_5xx_rate increased 15x on LAX1 between 09:42 and 09:48 PST. Autoretry fallback engaged.
emma Cho: Copy. I'm standing by to draft status page and customer note. Can someone confirm which customers are hitting LAX1 primarily?
luis Ramirez: CDN logs show traffic for some west-coast tenants still routing to LAX1. We have routing table entries: edge-lax1 -> origin-us-west2 (primary). Will run a quick route-shift.
devon Kline: Quick triage — edge process OOMs reported on 3/6 LAX1 frontends. Suspect a bad rollout of the edge-optimizer binary at 09:12. I'm rolling back the last deploy to edge-lax1 now.
ops-sre: FYI sysctl and kernel logs show "kworker stalled" on the same hosts. Rebooting node lax1-edge-03 into maintenance.
incident-bot: Rollback initiated: edge-optimizer v2.4.7 -> v2.4.6 on LAX1. ETA ~4m.
devon Kline: Rollback completed on 4/6 nodes. Two nodes still failing health checks (lax1-edge-05, lax1-edge-06). Holding while we investigate.
luis Ramirez: Emma — please prep a short status page entry. Keep it high level. Suggest copy below.
emma Cho: Draft status page update:```
Summary: Partial service degradation in LAX (edge-pop) causing higher error rates and timeouts for some requests. Impact: ~8% of requests routed through affected LAX1 edge-pop may see 5xx or increased latency. Mitigation: We are rolling back a recent edge optimization deploy and shifting traffic away from LAX1 to nearby regions while we recover. Next update: in 15 minutes or when we have new info.```
Please review.
customer-comms: Suggest adding note about retry behavior and recommended client-side backoff. Also tagging customers with long-lived streaming sessions for targeted email.
luis Ramirez: Good call. Add the note: "If you see transient failures, clients should retry with exponential backoff. We are not intentionally terminating customer streams."
emma Cho: Updated draft for status page and the targeted email. Email draft:```
Subject: Service disruption affecting some West Coast customers (LAX edge)
Hi — we detected a partial degradation impacting some traffic routed via our LAX edge-pop. Our engineers are rolling back a recent edge deploy and shifting traffic to nearby regions; many customers will see automatic recovery within minutes. If you rely on long-lived streaming sessions, you may experience transient disconnects — implementing client-side retry/backoff will help. We will follow up once the edge-pop is healthy. Sorry for the disruption. — Redwood Inference Status Team
```
luis Ramirez: Paging timeline: 09:42 issue detected, 09:44 incident created, 09:46 rollback started, 09:51 partial recovery on 4/6 nodes, 09:55 traffic shift initiated.
devon Kline: Traffic shift details (manual): update route weight:```
# run from routerctl
set-route edge-lax1 weight 0.2
set-route edge-us-west2 weight 0.8
```
This will let 20% of traffic remain on LAX1 for verification.
ops-sre: Implemented weight change. Monitoring error rate for both regions.
incident-bot: Note added: statuspage.io update queued by emma. Scheduled publish in 2m.
luis Ramirez: Customer comms: emma, send the targeted email to tenants with >5% traffic via LAX1. Also add a PS note mentioning we will provide a post-incident RCA.
emma Cho: Sending targeted notifications now. Also posting the public status update.
devon Kline: Health checks green on lax1-edge-01..04. lax1-edge-05 still failing FS mount; probable disk corruption. Opening a host repair ticket.
ops-sre: Disk repair in progress (SRV-4567). We will migrate any affected containers off before reformat.
luis Ramirez: Handoff: devon, you can stay as owner for the recovery runbook. I'll take postmortem notes and assemble comms. @ops-sre, loop in hardware team for hardware replacement for lax1-edge-05/06.
devon Kline: Acknowledged. Will continue monitoring for the next hour and then begin collection of logs for RCA.
emma Cho: Final planned update for now: "Mitigation in progress: rollback complete and traffic shifted; most customers recovering. Investigating two remaining nodes. Targeting full recovery within 2 hours." Posting now.
incident-bot: Incident INC-2029-LAX1-EDGE status changed to 'stabilizing'. Severity set to P1.
luis Ramirez: Good work team. After stabilization, let's schedule an all-hands postmortem and a comms timeline for customers who experienced errors (include token-level impact analysis).
customer-comms: Will draft the customer-facing RCA after technical RCA is available. Recommended estimate: 48-72 hours to full RCA.
ops-sre: For ops: add automated check to prevent edge-optimizer binary from being deployed to >2 nodes at once until we validate memory footprint.
devon Kline: Action items: 1) collect kernel logs from all LAX1 nodes; 2) preserve the rolled-back binary and release artifacts; 3) coordinate hardware replacement for failing hosts. I'll attach logs to the incident ticket.
luis Ramirez: Closing notes for thread: if anything regresses, escalate to paging again. Otherwise we'll move to RFC/RCAs in post-incident channel. :thumbsup:
